headline: Law gives the VA permission to carry out certain major medical facility building projects in fiscal year 2024, with spending caps for each.
what_it_does: This law authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to carry out specific major medical facility projects during fiscal year 2024. It also sets the most money that can be spent on each project. The summary does not list which projects or locations are included.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who get care at VA medical facilities
who_it_affects.how: The law allows the VA to move forward with certain major construction or renovation projects at facilities that serve veterans.
The VA gets legal approval to carry out the listed projects but must stay within the spending limit set for each one.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted November 25, 2024; covers projects for fiscal year 2024.
